executiveSummary: Replenish’s work centered on restart readiness and measurement. The client confirmed that the stores are open, and the follow-up specified current availability copy, campaign asset corrections, Get Directions tracking and advertiser verification as the steps to close. The campaign edits were reported staged. The latest platform snapshot still shows the selected Replenish campaigns ended, so this report does not present them as currently serving.

work.title: Store availability confirmed and page changes requested
work.detail: The client confirmed all stores are open. The follow-up requested replacing Coming soon and Coming this August wording on the five South Florida pages with current availability information.
work.whyItMatters: Aligns the customer journey with the actual store opening status.

work.title: Campaign corrections reported staged
work.detail: The follow-up identified Coral Springs copy that referred to Boca and an unrelated legacy sitelink. Later that day, the account reply reported the campaign-side changes staged and ready to publish. That message does not establish a live restart.
work.whyItMatters: Keeps location-specific messaging accurate before traffic resumes.

work.title: Tracking responsibilities and restart conditions documented
work.detail: The programmer was assigned the Google tag and Get Directions connection, with Momentum to validate the installed event. Page updates, a successful tracking test and advertiser verification were named as restart conditions.
work.whyItMatters: Connects directions intent to the correct reporting action instead of relying on page exits.

work.title: Location review and presentation work assigned
work.detail: Campaign delivery review by location and strategy notes were assigned to the supporting account team. The presentation still needs a verified August click-to-directions figure from the site reporting layer.
work.whyItMatters: Separates the advertising review from the website KPI that still requires evidence.

work.title: Client meeting proposed
work.detail: An email proposed meeting availability to review performance and next steps. A confirmed meeting date was not established in the reviewed thread.
work.whyItMatters: Provides a direct review point for the readiness checklist.

decisions.decision: Campaign restart depends on current store-page information, tested directions tracking and advertiser verification.

nextSteps.title: Finish the store-finder changes
nextSteps.detail: Replace outdated availability copy and confirm store details on each affected page.

nextSteps.title: Validate Get Directions measurement
nextSteps.detail: Test the correct Google Ads event on the shared finder and obtain the dated August directions figure.

nextSteps.title: Resolve verification and confirm restart
nextSteps.detail: Check advertiser verification and review the staged location assets before agreeing a restart. Ended campaigns are not a live launch.

caveats: The September 1 to 8 snapshot covers seven Replenish-prefixed campaigns. The August 31 destination audit discussed nine asset groups; these are different objects and dated scopes.
Website sessions are not store visits or drink purchases.
No causal explanation for a property-wide traffic change is established by the available channel summaries.
Google Ads includes September 8 only through the displayed collection time. The current day is partial and platform reporting is not real time.
headline: Make the path to store visits clear.
summaryFollow: The actions below separate verified changes, reported progress and work awaiting review.
coverNote: The work. The results. What comes next.
coverageStatement: Prepared from a September 8 review of dated account communications, available project artifacts and relevant working-session records. Platform figures below are independently dated.
researchNote: Source links and personal contact details remain in the private evidence file. This report contains only this client’s work and results.
background: On August 31, the account check already found all nine asset groups using the shared location finder. Changing every destination is not an outstanding task from that audit.
